name: FluidGlass-TS-TW
title: FluidGlass
description: A violet full-screen scene shows two large photos and a bold wordmark. A round glass disc follows the cursor, refracting and warping whatever passes beneath it.
use: A bold hero wants an eye-catching glass magnifier that tracks the pointer.
avoid: It needs WebGL and a sized parent, and touch users never get the lens effect.
a11y: The scene lives entirely in a WebGL canvas with no text alternative, and the lens ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A vivid violet backdrop holds a tall photo of dark rocks and surf on the left and a city skyline on the right, with large white lettering across the middle. A faint circular glass disc hovers over the scene.
behaves: The glass disc trails the pointer with a soft delay, bending and shifting the image under it with faint colour fringes at the rim. When the pointer stops, the scene settles back to flat.
customise: Mode (lens, bar or cube) and glass settings such as scale, refraction, thickness and chromatic aberration are props; the photos and wordmark are hardcoded.
weight: heavy: A three.js canvas renders every frame with a transmission material and an offscreen buffer.
